title: The bathroom shooting at Tân Sơn Nhứt
description: A drunk soldier from another company shot a man in the chest in the shower at the headquarters company latrine, right next to Larry's hooch. Larry, who did not know the victim, saw where the bullet hit and turned to help the wounded man — at which point the gunman pointed the pistol at Larry and aimed it at him. Sgt. Weaver, an E5, showed up; the shooter, eyes rolled back, passed out. Air Force police took Larry's statement. Larry heard the shooter knew the man he shot, and that he was sentenced to twenty years of hard labor, imprisoned in Okinawa. Larry's bunk mate Ron Tototz was with him during the incident. Larry dates it roughly February–March 1965 — 'been there at least 6 months.'
larrysRecollection: The guy shot a guy in the shower in the chest. He shot at the guy in the shower first, my father say where the bullet hit, turned to help the guy injured, the guy with the gun then pointed the gun at my father and aimed it at him. Sargent Weaver showed up. He was an E5. The guy with the gun was drunk with eyes rolled to the back of his head. He passed out. Airforce police showed up. Took my father's statement. The guy was from a different company / unit. Happened at Tah San hut headquarters company, right next to his hooch. Father didn't know the guy showering. Heard the shooter knew the guy in the shower, and he was imprisoned in Okinawa of hard labor for 20 years. (Tell a Story comment, relayed 2026-08-15; earlier fragments 2026-08-13)
